summary: STERIS Irish FinCo Unlimited Company, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of STERIS plc, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for $750 million of 5.650% senior notes due 2033 and $750 million of 5.875% senior notes due 2036, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by STERIS plc, STERIS Corporation and STERIS Limited. Interest pays semi-annually each June 15 and December 15 beginning June 15, 2027; notes are redeemable at stated optional redemption prices plus a tax redemption at par. Proceeds relate to the October 11, 2026 agreement to acquire Xodus Medical; a special mandatory redemption applies if the deal is not completed by the outside date or is terminated. Watch deal-close risk and any spread widening tied to the special mandatory redemption trigger.
